mapper.select: SELECT id, event_id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, locked_by, locked_until, last_error, created_at, updated_at FROM event_outbox WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE event_outbox SET status = 1, locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE event_outbox SET status = 2, retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL, last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE event_outbox SET status = 4, locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL, last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
